calendar_runtime.lunar_edge_policy: accept only a unique nominal label that converts inside 1901-01-01 through 2033-12-31

formula_lineage.name: tyme4ts
formula_lineage.role: inspected implementation lineage for four independently rewritten Dayun child-limit formulas only

shared_direction_and_term_rule.forward: Yang year-stem with man parameter, or Yin year-stem with woman parameter
shared_direction_and_term_rule.term_selection: Backward uses the previous-or-current Jie; forward uses the next Jie.
shared_direction_and_term_rule.implementation: project-code rewrite with MIT formula-lineage attribution

providers.implementation: project-code rewrite; no tyme4ts runtime dependency
providers.conversion: For absolute seconds to the selected Jie: 259200 s -> 1 symbolic year; 21600 s -> 1 month; 720 s -> 1 day; 30 s -> 1 hour; each remaining second -> 2 minutes.

providers.implementation: project-code rewrite; no tyme4ts runtime dependency
providers.conversion: Floor to whole minutes; 4320 min -> 1 symbolic year; 360 min -> 1 month; 12 min -> 1 day.

providers.implementation: project-code rewrite; no tyme4ts runtime dependency
providers.conversion: Uses solar-day difference plus traditional two-hour branch indices; each full day contributes 4 symbolic months and the branch-index remainder is converted to months and days.

providers.implementation: project-code rewrite; no tyme4ts runtime dependency
providers.conversion: Floor to whole minutes; 4320 min -> 1 symbolic year; 360 min -> 1 month; 12 min -> 1 day; each remaining minute -> 2 hours.
